title: Cloud NSS feed settings: HTTPS-only URLs and OAuth fields

prose.text: Cloud NSS feeds carry their own endpoint and OAuth settings, validated by the provider. The Go SDK's request handling is in [[shared.sdk-go.request-handling]].

checks.do: Whether a feed's destination and authentication URLs use HTTPS, which the provider validates before calling the API.
Whether OAuth is on and which SIEM types the authentication URL applies to.

https-only-urls.statement: The Terraform provider validates a Cloud NSS feed's connection_url and authentication_url as HTTPS URLs, so an http endpoint is rejected before the API is called.

quotes: The HTTPS URL of the SIEM log collection API endpoint

oauth-fields.statement: A Cloud NSS feed has an oauth_authentication switch, and its authentication URL is described as applying when the SIEM type is Azure Sentinel.

quotes: `oauth_authentication` - (Optional) A Boolean value indicating whether OAuth 2.0 authentication is enabled or not
`authentication_url` - (Optional) Authentication URL applicable when SIEM type is set to Azure Sentinel
